map.behavior: Draw the original paper behind held maps. Put the two native 1.11.2 black alpha levels into unexplored map-texture pixels, so the same content transform confines the checker to the 100px map square. Native found colours, icons, packets and coordinate caption are retained.
map.rendering: Use the native text/map vertex and lightmap path with a map-only alpha-blended fragment pass. The 1.17 text shader discards both original 16/255 and 24/255 pixels at its 0.1 cutoff, so the map pass removes that cutoff without changing fonts or other textures. Original paper pixels, found colours and UVs are retained. With OptiFine installed, the same draw saves/disables/restores its emulated alpha-test state so shaderpacks receive a zero cutoff for that pass.

intro.confirmation: UIScene_Intro::handleInput owns ACTION_MENU_OK and guards navigation with m_bIgnoreNavigate; UIController tracks pressed/released, while MainMenu forwards confirmed presses.
intro.fades: Original 30 fps labels and nine-frame fades; blending is restored after the white background because native GuiComponent.fill disables it.
intro.java_readiness: Before resource completion, confirm advances one logo; 4J holds. Once native completion is known, confirm exits the entire intro from any logo, per the user instruction. The consumed confirm remains blocked until release and cannot activate Play Game.
intro.scope: The original rating/Mojang/4J image bytes and initial music behavior are retained. Keyboard Enter/Space shares the same input ownership as controller Cross/A.

sleep.source: BedTile only announces when other players remain awake. ServerPlayer sends IDS_TILE_BED_MESLEEP to the sleeper and IDS_TILE_BED_PLAYERSLEEP, with the display name, to others. ClientConnection resolves both into chat.
sleep.scope: Default 100% sleeping rule uses the original messages once per new sleeper and suppresses Java count/skipping announcements. Vanilla server time progression and sleeping validation are unchanged. A non-100% Java sleep threshold retains its own text; unmodified-server sleep action-bar Components are routed into visible chat.
sleep.compatibility: Server announcements are plain text so clients without the mod can read them. Source-format announcements require this mod on the server.

buckets.source: BucketItem::TestUse plus Minecraft::GetActionTooltips; no mutating use, pickupBlock or emptyContents call is used to predict prompts.
java_extensions: Use the native Item POV ray trace and SOURCE_ONLY / NONE fluid rules, native permissions, BucketPickup source eligibility, waterlogging and fluid-container placement predicates.
Water buckets show Collect for native Bucketable fish/axolotls. Empty buckets show Collect for adult cows per the user request; the pinned C++ cow-specific label is Milk.
Filled water/lava buckets show Empty only on an eligible aimed block placement; no unconditional bucket prompt remains.

paper_doll.pose: Cancel the native world body angle in the render matrix, keep body rotation available to cape physics, align head/current-and-previous yaw to the body, and restore every modified player angle and dispatcher camera after drawing. Original source anchor, 12px scale and visibility timer are retained.

crouch_shield.origin: Requested 1.17 default, using the existing Legacy4J-inspired shield behavior.
crouch_shield.migration: Enable once for older profiles lacking controller.crouchShieldDefaults218; subsequent user opt-out persists. Fresh and reset defaults are true.
